datasource_ids.description: Already filtered by the API to data sources the organization owns. The AI service refuses any id outside this set.

datasource_names.description: Optional id -> display name map, used only to make the prompt readable.

document_ids.description: Restrict retrieval to these documents. Empty means all ready documents.

use_documents.description: When false, the document search tool is not offered to the model at all.

execution_id.description: Correlates the run with the API's execution record. Informational only; the API owns the record.
